text: Chest pain or trouble breathing during pregnancy or after birth can be a sign of a blood clot in the lungs or a heart problem. Both are emergencies. Call 911 or go to the emergency room immediately.
subtopic: chest pain or trouble breathing in pregnancy

text: Pain, swelling, redness, or warmth in one leg, especially the calf, can be a sign of a blood clot. Pregnancy and the weeks right after birth raise your risk. Do not massage the leg. Call your provider or go to the emergency room right away.
subtopic: leg pain or swelling — possible blood clot
